title: Paraguay President Santiago Peña resigns
summary: The move follows a bank collapse and after the lower house of congress voted in favour of pursuing an impeachment trial against him.

blocks.text: Paraguay's President Santiago Peña has announced his resignation following a political crisis sparked by the collapse of a bank linked to him.
"I want to apologise to the people if at any point I failed," he said in a video message on social media.
The political crisis in Paraguay erupted after financial institution Ueno Bank, which was linked to Peña, entered an insolvency process, which froze all operations.
Peña's resignation came after Paraguay's lower house of congress voted in favour of pursing an impeachment trial against him.
